description:
Context: packages/ticket-sync lists LICENSE in files[] and declares MIT license without shipping packages/ticket-sync/LICENSE (#788), and plugins/adlc-cursor, plugins/adlc-gemini, and plugins/adlc-herdr omit engines.node >=18 (#817, #824).
Requirements:
1. Add packages/ticket-sync/LICENSE matching the repository root MIT LICENSE (#788).
2. Add engines.node >=18 to plugins/adlc-cursor/package.json (#817), plugins/adlc-gemini/package.json (#824), and plugins/adlc-herdr/package.json.
3. Add a suite-wide invariant test in plugins/adlc-cursor/test/packaging.test.mjs asserting that every workspace package/plugin with a package.json declares engines.node and ships LICENSE on disk.
title: fix(packaging): ship LICENSE in ticket-sync and declare engines.node >=18 in cursor/gemini/herdr (#788, #817, #824)
